sloka: इत्युक्त: कैकयीपुत्र: काकुत्स्थेन महात्मना ।प्रगृह्य बलवद्भूय: प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥ २.१०४.४॥
transliteration: ityukta: kaikayīputra: kākutsthena mahātmanā ।pragṛhya balavadbhūya: prāñjalirvākyamabravīt ॥ 2.104.4॥

translations.english: Thus enquired by the magnanimous Rama, Bharata, joining his palms tightly, replied:
